subject: Recert Playbook: Term amendment & burst capacity request
messages:
From: Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@arcadiahealth.com
Date: 2026-11-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SOC2 recert + term question

Karthik — thanks for the quick call earlier. As we prepare to renew in Q1, our security team asked for a short playbook on what evidence you’ll provide for SOC 2 recertification and whether a temporary increase in log retention/window is available during our audit.

High-level asks from Arcadia:
- Inventory of SOC2 artifacts you can share (policy docs, evidence index, access logs)
- Option to extend audit log retention from 90 → 180 days for 60-day window around the audit
- Cost/term implications if we increase seats by +25% and add burst capacity for Black Friday prep in Nov 2027

Can you send a one-page plan and estimated commercial impact?

Thanks,
Mike
Director, IT Compliance
Arcadia Health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-28T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 recert + term question

Mike — added our security and account leads. Quick notes below; I’ll follow up with a concise playbook and a draft amendment.

Summary answers:
1) Evidence: we can provide a scoped evidence index (policies, SOC2 testing matrices, control owners, sample logs), and a short guided upload for any artifacts you need to submit. I attached the evidence index template we normally use.
2) Retention: we can offer a temporary retention uplift (90 → 180 days) for a 90-day audit window around the recert. It’s configurable as a time-limited add-on or baked into the term for an ongoing uplift.
3) Seats & burst: +25% seats is straightforward — we’ll propose a stepped pricing table and a 30% discount on transient burst capacity if committed with a 12‑ or 24‑month term.

Deliverables by EOD Monday:
- One-page recert playbook (what evidence we deliver + responsibilities)
- Commercial amendment draft with seat uplift, retention option pricing, and burst capacity block
- Proposed timeline for evidence handoff and upload runbook

Karthik
VP, Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment: soc2-evidence-index.xlsx (stub)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 recert + term question — Playbook draft and timeline

Hi all — attaching the playbook and retention matrix. Key points:
- Playbook covers evidence we control, evidence Arcadia must provide, and recommended sampling cadence for controls testing.
- Two options for retention uplift: (A) temporary 90-day uplift around audit window (one-time fee), (B) permanent 180-day retention included in term (recurring fee). Pricing examples in the matrix.
- Timeline: evidence handoff week of Jan 4, 2027; control sampling week of Jan 18–29; final attest work Feb 5–9. We can compress by one week if Arcadia can upload consolidated artifacts by Jan 6.

Next actions for Arcadia:
1) Confirm preferred retention option (temp vs ongoing)
2) Confirm seat uplift number and whether seat increase is committed at renewal or staged after go-live
3) Approve commercial amendment draft — we’ve included a DocuSign link below for convenience

Thanks — Grace
Director, Customer Success (Security Practice)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: log-retention-matrix.pdf, amendment-draft-v2.docx
Related link: https://redwood.box.com/s/evidence-bucket/Arcadia
From: Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@arcadiahealth.com, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 recert + term question — Playbook draft and timeline

Grace/Karthik — this looks good. A few clarifications from our side:
- We prefer option B (permanent 180-day retention) if the annual cost delta is < $15k; otherwise we’ll take the temporary uplift for the audit window.
- Seats: we expect to add 120 seats at renewal; can you propose PRICING for commit levels: +60 (stepped), +120 (full), and a staged +60 now +60 after Q2?
- Burst: we want a guaranteed 2x burst capacity block for up to 48 hours during Nov 2027. What does the SLA look like for guaranteed capacity and what is the cancellation window?

Can you update the amendment to show the three seat paths and the burst SLA language? We’re aiming to sign by Jan 20 to avoid procurement delays.

Mike
Director, IT Compliance
Arcadia Health
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Jensen <mike.jensen@arcadiahealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-02T15:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 recert + term question — Playbook draft and timeline

Mike — thanks. I updated the amendment draft with a three-path pricing table and appended the burst-capacity SLA clause (guaranteed warm standby within 6 hours, 2x capacity for up to 48 hours; cancellation window 72 hours). Commercial highlights in short:
- +60 seats: pro-rated at renewal, 10% one-time uplift discount
- +120 seats: 12-month commit, 18% volume discount; preferred for budgeting
- Staged +60/+60: staged pricing with a lock-in rate for Q2 top-up
- Permanent 180-day retention: estimated incremental $12,500/year for Arcadia at current usage profile (see retention matrix).

I’ve attached the updated amendment link and added a DocuSign quick-sign URL. If that looks good, we can present a final to procurement and run legal redlines the week of Jan 11.

Jonas
Head of Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: amendment-draft-v3.docx (link via HubSpot)
Related link: https://hubspot.company/contacts/ACM-4982
